## Review

Two readers, two halves (AGENTS.md, "Git"). A box is ticked by the reader who
read for it, after reading.

- [ ] The logic, the security, the tests and the reliability hold.
- [ ] The UX holds: the words, the screens and the merchant's path through them.

## Before merging

- [ ] CI is green on the last commit.
- [ ] A change to `@nuanu-ai/agentify` or `@nuanu-ai/agentify-contracts` carries a Changeset.
- [ ] A decision this changes is edited in `docs/decisions/` in this same request.
- [ ] If it was tried on the test channel, the other person knew `deploy-test` moved.
